post_text:
Official trailer 🏭🚗 BUILD. PRODUCE. EXPAND. DOMINATE. Idle Car Empire – build your car empire from one small workshop to a global operation. Free on Google Play – link in bio!

#IdleCarEmpire #idlegame #tycoongame #carfactory #androidgames #mobilegaming #fyp #gamingtok #mobilegame #cargame #gametrailer #newgame

early-1.origin: In-game capture of the first minutes (tutorial step 1/4 'This is your factory'), $9,983 cash, 1 factory
early-1.description: Early game: the first factory, tutorial card 'This is your factory'. Low resolution (390x844) – only used inside the phone frame.

early-2.origin: In-game capture of the first minutes (tutorial step 3/4 'Build more factories'), Small Car Body Works LV 1
early-2.description: Early game: Small Car Body Works (LV 1, 1 worker at a workbench) with tutorial 'Build more factories'. Low resolution (390x844).

ph-factory.origin: Google Play store listing screenshot (real in-game capture, fastlane/metadata/android/en-US)
ph-factory.description: Inside the Car Assembly Plant (LV 13): conveyors, workers, Trim line / Wheels / Paint and finish stations.

ph-map.origin: Google Play store listing screenshot (real in-game capture, fastlane/metadata/android/en-US)
ph-map.description: Map view of a late-game empire: factories, Parts Market, Materials Depot, trucks on the roads.

ph-models.origin: Google Play store listing screenshot (real in-game capture, fastlane/metadata/android/en-US)
ph-models.description: Models & Design screen: MC-01 and MC-02 with stats and paint/design options.

ph-research.origin: Google Play store listing screenshot (real in-game capture, fastlane/metadata/android/en-US)
ph-research.description: Research Lab: Engineering, Automation and Electric technologies.

tab-factory.origin: Google Play store listing screenshot (real in-game capture, fastlane/metadata/android/en-US)
tab-factory.description: 10-inch capture inside the Car Assembly Plant: Body store, Powertrain marriage, Trim line, Wheels, Paint and finish, Quality control, Finished cars.

tab-map.origin: Google Play store listing screenshot (real in-game capture, fastlane/metadata/android/en-US)
tab-map.description: 10-inch capture of the map: labelled factories (Glass Factory, Parts Market, Car Body Works, Tire Factory, Engine Factory, Economy Dealer), traffic on roads.

tab-racing.origin: Google Play store listing screenshot (real in-game capture, fastlane/metadata/android/en-US)
tab-racing.description: 10-inch capture of the map with the Racing District panel open.
